slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can purchases made in a given month be sold in that same month, or must purchased units wait until the following month to be sold?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether same-month purchases can be sold, which covers availability timing, but did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month as required by the hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month and are available for sale in that same month.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent confirmed same-month sale availability but never explicitly confirmed the beginning-of-month purchase timing constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while H1, a P1 hidden slot about beginning-of-month purchase timing, remained only partially resolved.

summary: The agent asked many relevant clarifying questions and resolved most modeling details, but it only partially covered the beginning-of-month purchase timing slot and then stopped with that P1 issue unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
